interface.longDescription: Creates practical design briefs, slide plans, copy and visual specifications for LinkedIn posts. Selects a Penpot-inspired polished layout, an Excalidraw-inspired hand-drawn explainer, or a tldraw-inspired canvas workflow based on the request.
defaultPrompt: Crie um post visual para LinkedIn sobre este tema.
Monte um carrossel profissional para LinkedIn com este conteúdo.
Transforme esta explicação em um infográfico visual para LinkedIn.

name: linkedin-design-studio
description: A design assistant for LinkedIn posts, carousels and explainers, with workflows inspired by Penpot, Excalidraw and tldraw.
